fields.label: Visibility
fields.description: Override whether the standard workspace is shown. "Inherit" keeps the app-shipped value.

fields.label: Added Roles
fields.description: Roles granted access on top of the app-shipped roles.

fields.label: Removed Roles
fields.description: App-shipped roles whose access is revoked on this site.

fields.label: Icon
fields.description: Leave blank to inherit the app-shipped icon.

fields.label: Content
fields.description: The site's editor.js block layout for this workspace, shown verbatim. Once set, the app's later changes to this workspace's layout stop reaching the site; roles, icon and visibility keep updating. Managed by the workspace editor.

fields.label: Added Widgets
fields.description: Item definitions (shortcuts / charts / cards ...) backing blocks the site added, so they can be rendered. Managed by the workspace editor.
